sources.finding: the wild-type pectoral fin area at 72 hpf is NOT reported in absolute units in the text: the paper gives only the mutant change relative to wild type (+65% area, +50% dorsoventral size; anterior/posterior size not significantly affected). Absolute values exist only as bar charts in Figure 2H-I, which were not digitised.

adult.reference_SL_mm.note: used only to evaluate the Parichy regressions at adult size

adult.max_body_depth_over_SL.measure: body depth at the dorsal fin origin / SL
adult.max_body_depth_over_SL.derivation: 1 / 3.49, the mean SL-to-depth ratio of control zebrafish
adult.max_body_depth_over_SL.note: applied as the depth at the dorsal fin origin, which is also the model's maximum depth

adult.depth_at_nape_over_SL.derivation: Parichy 2009 Table 3, 'Prediction of SL and HAA from other quantitative measures': SL = 4.12 x X + 1.62, evaluated at SL = 25.7 mm (Hur 2017); beyond ~15 mm SL the regressions depart moderately from linearity

adult.depth_at_anal_origin_over_SL.measure: height at anterior margin of anal fin (HAA) / SL
adult.depth_at_anal_origin_over_SL.derivation: Parichy 2009 Table 3, 'Prediction of SL and HAA from other quantitative measures': SL = 3.56 x X + 4.40, evaluated at SL = 25.7 mm (Hur 2017); beyond ~15 mm SL the regressions depart moderately from linearity

adult.head_length_over_SL.derivation: Parichy 2009 Table 3, 'Prediction of SL and HAA from other quantitative measures': SL = 3.29 x X + 0.73, evaluated at SL = 25.7 mm (Hur 2017); beyond ~15 mm SL the regressions depart moderately from linearity

adult.eye_diameter_over_SL.derivation: Parichy 2009 Table 3, 'Prediction of SL and HAA from other quantitative measures': SL = 9.49 x X + 0.22, evaluated at SL = 25.7 mm (Hur 2017); beyond ~15 mm SL the regressions depart moderately from linearity

adult.snout_vent_over_SL.derivation: Parichy 2009 Table 3, 'Prediction of SL and HAA from other quantitative measures': SL = 1.48 x X + 0.55, evaluated at SL = 25.7 mm (Hur 2017); beyond ~15 mm SL the regressions depart moderately from linearity

adult.vertebrae_total.measure: vertebrae (4 Weberian + 10 precaudal + 15 caudal + 3 caudal fin)
adult.vertebrae_total.derivation: 3-4 caudal fin vertebrae reported, 3 used; Van Wynsberghe 2023 gives 31

adult.caudal_fin_principal_rays.derivation: inferred from 'fewer than 18 principal rays' in treated fish

adult.gill_arches_per_side.measure: gill-bearing branchial arches per side (branchial arches 1-4)

larva.reference_SL_mm.measure: standardized SL at posterior swim bladder inflation (pSB, Table 4)
larva.reference_SL_mm.note: the model is a ~4-5 dpf larva at the onset of swim bladder inflation; dpf is a poor stage proxy (Parichy 2009)

larva.depth_at_nape_over_SL.derivation: Parichy 2009 Table 3, 'Prediction of SL and HAA from other quantitative measures': SL = 4.12 x X + 1.62, evaluated at SL = 3.5 mm (pSB milestone), near the low end of the fitted range

larva.head_length_over_SL.derivation: Parichy 2009 Table 3, 'Prediction of SL and HAA from other quantitative measures': SL = 3.29 x X + 0.73, evaluated at SL = 3.5 mm (pSB milestone), near the low end of the fitted range

larva.eye_diameter_over_SL.derivation: Parichy 2009 Table 3, 'Prediction of SL and HAA from other quantitative measures': SL = 9.49 x X + 0.22, evaluated at SL = 3.5 mm (pSB milestone), near the low end of the fitted range

larva.snout_vent_over_SL.derivation: Parichy 2009 Table 3, 'Prediction of SL and HAA from other quantitative measures': SL = 1.48 x X + 0.55, evaluated at SL = 3.5 mm (pSB milestone), near the low end of the fitted range

larva.swim_bladder_lobes.measure: swim bladder lobes at inflation (single posterior lobe)

larva.eye_diameter.note: direct measurements (~0.07-0.08 of body length) are smaller than the Parichy regression value at 3.5 mm SL (0.099 SL); the model uses the regression

larva.pectoral_fin_area_wt_72hpf.note: not reported in absolute units; only +65% in hhip (uki) mutants relative to wild type
